text:
**Accuracy.** Both responses get the dates, the 8% figure, the 15-minute switch time and the conditions right. Both correctly report that the shutdown moved to 31 January 2027.

Response A has one inaccuracy. It labels the new features "(automatic)", but area-based shift swap approvals have to be set up in Admin > Permissions > Areas. A manager reading A could assume this just works and never configure it. Response B makes no such claim, so it is accurate throughout.

**Key points.** A's strengths are that it leads with the action item and includes the menu path, the help-centre guide and the "staff could be paid late" consequence. B leaves these out, but "timesheets will stop reaching payroll" still conveys the risk. B also usefully notes the change from 30 Nov, and it reassures readers that most customers need do nothing.

**Concision.** A comes to roughly 120–125 words, so it is at or slightly over the limit. B sits comfortably under it.

Because accuracy comes first, A's misleading "automatic" label and borderline length outweigh its extra detail.

Verdict: B
